name: CtrlS Lucknow Edge Datacenter
notes: CtrlS official page lists a carrier-neutral edge datacenter in Gomti Nagar, Lucknow: 49 racks capacity, 0.20 MW IT load (datacentermap lists 0.18 MW), 2,500 sq ft on a partial floor. Operational colocation facility serving enterprise and hyperscale customers.

name: Sify Lucknow Edge Data Center
notes: Sify chairman Raju Vegesna stated on the Q1 FY2026-27 earnings call (quarter ended Jun 30, 2026) that Sify has completed edge data centers in Lucknow and Chandigarh and is constructing two more, targeting 2-3 edge DCs per year in tier-2/3 cities; ET reported the same February 2025 plan with ~10 MW small-capacity 'AI factory' sites in cities including Lucknow. Exact Lucknow capacity not published; facility is operational as of mid-2026.

name: Uttar Pradesh State Data Centre (Lucknow)
notes: Official UP government portals (ODOP, UPDESCO-hosted sites) state their websites are hosted at the Uttar Pradesh State Data Centre, Lucknow; ET Government reports the UP State Data Centre hosts 250 services of 61 departments with a dedicated helpdesk at UPLC Lucknow. Government e-governance data centre, operational.

name: National Data Centre - Census of India (Disaster Recovery Site), Lucknow
developer: Census of India / Office of the Registrar General (Government of India)
notes: India's third National Data Centre, inaugurated 26 Feb 2021 at the UP State Census Directorate, Lucknow, as an upgraded data capture centre and disaster recovery site storing census data of all Indian states, with Delhi and Bengaluru NDCs as primary sites. Operated by government officials; no commercial capacity published.

name: Uttar Pradesh planned data center cluster - Lucknow
developer: Multiple prospective investors (Hiranandani/Yotta, NTT, Adani, ST Telemedia, Sify, Web Werks et al.) / Government of Uttar Pradesh
notes: ETDatacenters (Jun 23, 2026) reports UP has approved nearly Rs 21,343 crore of data center investment proposals to be distributed across Noida, Yamuna Expressway Region, Lucknow, Varanasi, Prayagraj, Meerut and Sitapur, with 644 MW committed capacity and a 2 GW-by-2030 state target. Lucknow is named among the locations but no specific Lucknow site/developer capacity is allocated in the report.
